role: post-v2/v3 explanatory decomposition; not independent confirmation
trigger: v1 full conditional identity transfer was positive, whereas v2 residual individual-by-location interaction and v3 marginal-only altitude identity did not meet their frozen support rules.

model.shared_spatial_template: P_species(z|cell), the equal-individual early species conditional distribution.
model.species_marginal: P_species(z), the equal-individual early marginal distribution.
model.individual_marginal: P_i(z) shrunk toward P_species(z) by lambda equivalent events.
model.reweighted_shared_template: P_i_reweight(z|cell) proportional to P_species(z|cell) * P_i(z)/P_species(z). No individual-by-cell residual is fitted.

primary_test.pairwise_gain: For source individual i and target late individual j, mean log P_i_reweight(z|cell) - log P_species(z|cell).
primary_test.observed: mean identity-matched diagonal gain across eight individuals
primary_test.null: all 8! permutations of source individual reweightings assigned to late target identities
primary_test.one_sided_p: fraction of all permutations with assigned mean gain >= observed diagonal mean
primary_test.support_rule: P <= 0.05 and at least 6 of 8 diagonal gains > 0
primary_test.interpretation_if_pass: individual specificity is largely expressible as individual-specific reweighting of a shared species spatial template, without requiring an independently supported individual-by-location residual interaction
primary_test.interpretation_if_fail: the v1 identity signal is not captured by either marginal-only, residual-spatial, or shared-template reweighting decompositions

prohibited: post-hoc change to lambda, cells, bins, or split after v4 output
